name: Midjourney Style Mega Pack — 250 Curated Prompts Across 25 Aesthetics
tagline: 250 copy-paste Midjourney prompts grouped into 25 distinct visual styles — for designers, marketers, and creators who want consistent, on-brand imagery in seconds.

deliverables_planned.prompts_csv: prompts.csv — flat export, columns: style, prompt, model_version, aspect_ratio, suggested_use
deliverables_planned.prompt_engineering_guide_pdf: How to adapt the prompts to your own brand voice

self_promotion_angle: Buyers post their AI-generated art in #hashtags and tag the pack; the visual variety (25 styles) makes social posts stand out from the saturated prompt-template market.
target_buyer: Designers, marketers, content creators, founders doing visual brand work without an art director.
v1_remaining_work: Verify all 250 prompts compile to single-line, copy-paste-ready text (remove multi-line breaks, escape Midjourney parameters correctly) — 30 min
Finalize prompts.csv with consistent column ordering: style, prompt, model_version (v6.1), aspect_ratio, suggested_use — 15 min
Generate 1 cover PNG (1600x2000) from cover-prompt.md using Midjourney v6.1 — 30 min
Generate 25 style-thumb PNGs (400x400 each) for the style-cheat-sheet — 2-3 hours in Midjourney (or use simple Canva grid) — reduce to 60 min via Canva mockup approach
Assemble style-cheat-sheet.pdf from the 25 thumbnails + style names in a single A4 grid — 20 min
Export prompt-engineering-guide.md to a styled .pdf — 20 min

blockers: no binary cover or mockup assets yet, content is text-only so it's close to ship-ready
build_to_revenue_path.shipping_tip: The text prompts ARE the product. You can list on Gumroad today by exporting the markdown as a single PDF — split cover + style preview + prompts into a 30-page PDF and ship. Etsy can wait for the styled .pdf + mockup.
